newsitem.title: UK: M&C Saatchi wins "Vanish" and other ad account.
newsitem.headline: M&C Saatchi wins "Vanish" and other ad account.

text.p: Advertising agency M&C Saatchi said on Thursday it had been awarded a four-million-pound ($6.5-million) UK account by Benckiser, the German household products company.
The agency will create a new campaign for Benckiser's Vanish stain removal brand.
M&C Saatchi said the British market for stain removal products was worth 26 million pounds and was growing by 11 percent a year.

It said Procter & Gamble Co's recent launch in the UK of a product called Ace Gentle Bleach showed there was "renewed interest" in the product line. P&G is one of top competitors of the German-based company, whose full name is Joh A. Benckiser GmbH.

"Vanish is the market leader in a category which is hotting up. Benckiser is an ambitious company determined to produce ads which will increase their leadership status," said an M&C Saatchi spokesman.
Marketing Week magazine said on April 10 the Ace bleach detergent was P&G's first entirely new product launch in the UK laundry market for 20 years.

M&C Saatchi said on Thursday it had also been appointed by magazine publisher Haymarket to run an ad campaign for its TV magazine "The Box", which is aimed at men aged 25 to 45. Details of the budget have not been revealed.
